booth_config.description: Path to the booth site configuration file used for site-specific settings.

booth_port.description: UDP port on which booth listens for cluster communication (must match across all nodes).

booth_auth.description: Authentication method for booth messages. Use 'none' only in trusted environments.

booth_authfile.description: Path to the shared secret file used when auth=file. Must be identical on all nodes.

booth_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting for responses from remote booth sites.

booth_retry.description: Number of retries before a remote site is considered unreachable.

sites.description: List of booth sites (clusters) participating in the arbitration decision.

name.description: Human-readable name for the site (used in logs).

addr.description: IP address or resolvable hostname of the booth site.

priority.description: Priority (0–255); higher priority wins in split-brain resolution. Default: 128.

arbitrators.description: Optional list of arbitrator nodes (external passive observers for quorum).

addr.description: IP address or hostname of the arbitrator site.

resource_name.description: Name of the Pacemaker resource agent (must match an RA registered in OCF or LSF).

resource_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for start/stop/monitor operations to complete.

resource_start_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) after Pacemaker initiates the resource before it becomes active.

resource_monitor_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks (monitor operations) on the booth resource.

quorum_loss_action.description: Pacemaker action to take on the booth resource when cluster quorum is lost.
